tasks.description: Update the Postgres source setup docs: the **Schema** field is no longer required for warehouse imports — Postgres sources can browse and import tables across all non-system schemas, and same-named tables from different schemas can coexist. Adjust the field description and setup steps accordingly.

Document per-column selection for Postgres data warehouse imports and direct queries: users can choose which source columns to sync (all columns by default), primary keys and the active incremental field are always retained, disabled columns are hidden from queryable table schemas, and column selection is available in the new-source wizard, the source schemas tab, and the schema configuration page (with a sync-forward-only vs full-resync prompt when adding columns to a schema with prior sync history).

In the general 'Link a source' sync methods docs, add a note that for supported sources (e.g. Postgres) you can select which columns to sync per table, that all columns sync by default, and that primary key and incremental field columns are always included.
